description: Posts that are written correctly (draft 13.2: zero false BLOCKs). Fixtures as they are, plus rewrites that exercise the places a text gate could wrongly block: dialect words that are ordinary in another register (دول, كانت, مو, وش), alternative calls to action and plain sentences. The text gates (run.mjs, run.py) must report no BLOCK for any of them; lesser findings are counted. A corpus of real posts is kept private and is run the same way by the owner. Fields as in corpus-bad/defects.json.
